messages:
noah: Heads-up: we’re kicking off a small gated preview for MI450X Dedicated pools in Tallinn (TLL) and Bogotá (BOG) next Thursday at 09:00 local. Pilot-only, tiny capacity. Please read the runbook before nominating pilots.

yara: What’s new policy-wise for this rollout?

noah: Two new behaviors: 1) flex-burst mode (customers can opt a portion of reserved capacity into a shared burst pool), and 2) per-tenant recycle tokens to smooth short-term spikes. Flex-burst is reversible with a 1h reclaim window.

shaun: Quick defs: flex-burst = reserve converts X% -> burstable; if others use it you still pay the reserved baseline plus preemptible minutes for the extra usage. Recycle tokens are per-minute credits that slowly replenish; when tokens are gone requests are throttled to baseline qps.

ops-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mi450x-tll-bog-flex-burst (internal) :link: 

yara: Console/CLI: UI has a slider in Dedicated > Pools > MI450X (preview) for flex-burst % and an opt-in toggle. CLI example: 
```
redwood pools reserve --pool mi450x-tll --capacity 3 --flex-burst 20 --opt-in-recycle true
```

shaun: Runtime note: MI450X uses new quantized kernels. If you’re on Private, upgrade drivers to 6.5.x+ and runtime shim 2.4.1. We provided a compatibility checklist in the runbook.

noah: Billing: preview pricing = 60% of GA reserved list. Billing will tag usage with "mi450x_preview" and emit separate lines for "flex_burst_consumption" so customers can see charges. No SLA during preview.

billing-team: Confirmed. We’ll also show a sample invoice in the Console billing docs for pilot accounts.

shaun: Migration tips: start with tiny canaries, enable KV prefix caching, and keep request_timeouts >= 90s for long-context workloads. For heavy context workloads prefer bf16 variants to avoid fp16 edge-cases we saw in internal evals.

yara: Ops: metrics to watch: recycle_token_balance, flex_burst_util, p95_latency, and reclaim_failures. Dashboards created under Dedicated > Pools > MI450X (preview). Alert: reclaim_failures > 3 in 15m -> ops page.

noah: Pilot nominations: PMs/SEs DM me tenant ids + expected peak QPS. Ops will reserve daytime slots and one nightly buffer per pilot. Please read runbook before asking for access. :sparkles:
